quy_tac: When the line describes animal actions or journeys, the channel shows a wide shot of the animal in its natural environment.
When the line introduces abstract biological concepts or internal bodily mechanisms, the channel shows symbolic illustrations with metaphors like clocks or anatomical cutaways.
When the line mentions specific geographical locations, the channel shows an exterior landscape view labeled with the place name.
When the line discusses human aging or statistical risk, the channel shows a medium shot of a human figure alongside comparative charts.
When the line lists specific organs or biological features, the channel shows dedicated iconic symbols representing each feature.
When the line introduces answers or layers of secrets, the channel shows symbolic illustrations with a question mark.
When the line mentions personal fitness or human body evolution, the channel shows a character flexing muscles.
When the line addresses channel analytics, comments, or statistics, the channel shows actual screen captures of YouTube dashboards.
When the line features a narrator speaking directly or expressing gratitude, the channel shows a medium shot of a character gesturing.
When the line introduces a story setting or a specific character like Aunt Tu, the channel shows a medium shot of a person next to a stack of bowls and a shop sign.
When the line compares two equal concepts or stats, the channel shows a clean minimalist side-by-side comparison diagram or bar chart.
When the line introduces an action or narrative scenario, the channel shows a character physically interacting with objects in a medium shot.
When the line explains daily risk or danger over time, the channel shows an unstable object about to fall or break.
When the line lists key elements or characters of a story location, the channel shows a close-up insert grouping symbolic objects together.
When the line talks about clearing or discarding a wrong idea, the channel shows a character physically sweeping up trash with a broom.
When the line mentions a widely believed but incorrect statement, the channel shows a text card crossed out with a red prohibition sign.
